svg.aria-label: A web app's pipeline on ciburst, 2026-11-05: Rust, TypeScript and Playwright, 20 jobs in five stages, with its measured seconds, sped up. Manual jobs left out.

g.text: Lanes: Serverless Jobs, billed per second
minute 55: the idle VM ends itself
A push: GitLab creates 20 jobs in five stages.
Each job's event reaches the dispatcher. Eight jobs without needs start at once, each in a lane of its image.
The lanes pull their images and run: checks and tests side by side, each billed per second.
site-image-dev needs Docker and no VM is up: the dispatcher starts one.
The VM is up after 70 s and takes site-image-dev.
deploy-site-dev follows on the VM; verify-site-dev and monitor-site-dev check the site from lanes.
rust-test and ts-test passed: four Playwright jobs get lanes, build-image the warm VM.
A lane whose job is done waits 60 s for another job of its image, then ends.
build-image runs for ten minutes on the VM while the e2e jobs finish.
stack-test and deploy-dev follow on the same VM.
verify-dev and monitor-dev check the deployment from lanes.
The last lane has ended. The VM idles in the hour it is paid for.
Minute 55 of its hour: the idle VM ends itself. Between pipelines nothing runs.
